question: How should request expiry and cancellation fence completion while retaining supervisor holds until process termination is confirmed?
scope: Admission expiry and managed task deadlines
Atomic cancellation/completion decision with retained process holds
Bounded sweep and operator audit of unassigned closed pool work

evidence.summary: Cancel and pool assignment take generation then collection lock; delivery cancellation and completion serialize on delivery row. Winning stop invalidates lease atomically but never finishes wake. Pool close retains audit without delivery and is excluded from assignment/counts. Sweeps are bounded and leave holds intact. Review has separate closed-pool cursor and local reason; public status omits reason.

evidence.summary: Supervisor owns transient unit, polls controlled stop, and uses independent 30-second cleanup context to stop and confirm empty group before finish. Every added timeout cancel is called: 15-second start defer, 5-second poll each call, worker runtime defer plus explicit cancel before heartbeat join. Worker owns renewal goroutine and receives its completion before report; report has separate bounded context so cancellation does not prevent reporting. Unit RuntimeMaxSec retains deadline after supervisor death; stop has five-second grace. API errors take cleanup path. Native/manual active work refuses cancellation because no isolated unit exists.

assertions.text: Concurrent cancellation/completion and pool assignment/cancellation tests produce one durable target/outcome; stop decisions invalidate completion while retaining wake holds until finish.
Disposable systemd tests confirm detached children stop before hold release and task deadlines stop children even after supervisor death. The restarted supervisor reconciles the retained hold.
Keep PostgreSQL stop decisions separate from confirmed cgroup cleanup. Refuse active native/manual cancellation and unsupported deadline destinations until a per-request host contract exists.

alternatives.option: Record stop under delivery lock, then supervisor confirms group emptiness before finishing hold
Release delivery hold immediately when cancellation is requested
Kill an interactive CLI or shared gateway as a substitute for per-request native cancellation
Leave request lifetime unbounded beyond the existing worker timeout

verification_criteria: Full disposable integration with race detector and static checks
Actual cgroup stop and supervisor death/restart probes
reopening_conditions: A native host gains isolated per-request interruption and completion observation
New claim paths or delivery writers alter collection/delivery lock ordering
Measured control-poll or sweep load exceeds selected operating limits
residual_risk: Shutdown includes polling, host scheduling and five-second systemd stop grace; no real-time deadline guarantee.
No native/manual running hard stop, external effects rollback, provider-specific task acceptance, throughput or full-v1 acceptance claim.
Source inspection and tests establish the selected bounded contract; they do not prove all failure schedules or arbitrary future consumers.
